intended_object: This is a finite set of pentagon–rectangle decompositions, used in the proof that the grid homology commutation map is a chain map. It is the image of the counted "initial cross overlap sources" under an injective recutting map. I inferred this from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition takes the finset `initialPentagonInitialCrossOverlapSources`, attaches membership proofs, and maps it along the injective recut map `initialPentagonInitialCrossOverlapPartner`. The result is a bookkeeping device for a cancellation argument. It pairs one kind of domain decomposition with another so that terms cancel in the proof that the grid-homology commutation map commutes with the differential (the ∂H + H∂ identity). The grid-homology literature has no standalone notion that this corresponds to; it is an internal proof construction. So the verdict is `not_a_mathematical_object`.
